records.invariant: Invalid order locations never dereference LOB state.
records.limitations: Does not prove exchange feed correctness or complete application-level concurrency safety.

records.invariant: Malformed ITCH lengths and semantic fields are rejected without a test-process failure.
records.inputs: CTest fixtures and repository fuzz smoke inputs
records.limitations: Does not replace protocol-complete fuzzing or real MoldUDP64 capture replay.

records.invariant: Sequence gaps, duplicates, and out-of-order values are classified deterministically.
records.inputs: Synthetic sequence values 100, 101, 104, 104, 102, followed by reset
records.limitations: Does not prove MoldUDP64 packet capture, replay, recovery, or venue transport behavior.

records.invariant: LOB mutation and shared reads obey the documented ownership boundary.
records.limitations: A bounded smoke run does not prove race freedom across every application boundary.

records.invariant: MoldUDP64 headers and declared length-prefixed message counts reject truncated, mismatched, or trailing input deterministically.
records.inputs: Synthetic 20-byte header with two valid messages and one truncated message block
records.limitations: Does not prove NIC framing, packet loss recovery, exchange behavior, or venue certification.

records.invariant: Admission rejects invalid orders and enforces bounded active capacity.
records.limitations: Does not establish venue-specific risk controls, credentials, or operator authorization.

records.invariant: Corrupt or truncated recovery records are rejected deterministically.
records.inputs: CTest local recovery and audit fixtures
records.limitations: Does not prove external immutable retention, backup, or disaster recovery.

records.invariant: The simulated execution path reports reproducible percentile latency.
records.limitations: Target-hardware latency, jitter, cache behavior, and production SLA remain open.

scope_statement: This evidence set supports controlled local software validation only. It does not authorize production deployment or real-money trading.
